name: starflask_generate_video
description: Create a Starflask video generation job. Returns a job id immediately — poll with starflask_get_job until status is 'completed', then read result.video_url. For text-to-video use the default model_key kling-text2video with a `prompt`. For image-to-video (animate a still), set `model_key` to kling-img2video and pass `image_url` (a url from starflask_upload_media or a prior image job) plus an optional `prompt`. `duration` is in seconds. Use starflask_list_models to see available video models and their params.

prompt.description: Text description of the video (or motion guidance when animating an image).

model_key.description: Optional video model key. Defaults to kling-text2video; use kling-img2video for image-to-video.

image_url.description: Optional source image URL to animate (from starflask_upload_media). Requires an image-to-video model like kling-img2video.
